# Mandate

> Tool-agnostic spend-control proxy for agencies running AI agents. Keep real OpenAI/Anthropic keys encrypted server-side; issue capped `mdt_live_…` keys; point any compatible SDK, agent, backend, automation, or HTTP client at Mandate base URLs.

Base URL (production): https://trymandate.dev
OpenAI proxy: https://trymandate.dev/openai/v1
Anthropic proxy: https://trymandate.dev/anthropic/v1
